 17.1 Rakibul Hossan to Usman Khan, 1 run, to deep extra cover Rakibul Hossan, right-arm leg break, comes into the attack Drinks. Pakistan are coasting along. They haven't looked troubled much. Bangladesh would still want to take a few wickets and drag this game for as long as they can. Over 17 101-0 0 1 0 1 1 2 ( 5 runs) Hayam Khan 54 (57) Usman Khan 47 (45) Robiul Hasan Anik 2-0-13-0 Over Summary View all overs 16.6 Robiul Hasan Anik to Hayam Khan, 2 runs, pulled back near the fence after Hayam Khan hung back to dab it down behind square. That was well played by Hayam Khan 16.5 Robiul Hasan Anik to Usman Khan, 1 run, plays that down to long-off for a single 16.4 Robiul Hasan Anik to Hayam Khan, 1 run, smacks the short ball, pulls it, the man at mid-wicket stops it somehow. But he did take his eyes off the ball as that was hit hard. That allowed the duo to sneak in a single 16.3 Robiul Hasan Anik to Hayam Khan, no run, hangs back and defends it down into the off-side 16.2 Robiul Hasan Anik to Usman Khan, 1 run, flatter one, outside off, patted down to deep cover for a single 16.1 Robiul Hasan Anik to Usman Khan, no run, tossed up delivery, Usman Khan drives it down to cover with an open face of the bat Over 16 96-0 1 4 4 1 1 1 ( 12 runs) Usman Khan 45 (42) Hayam Khan 51 (54) SK Jarif Siyam 5-0-26-0 Over Summary View all overs 15.6 SK Jarif Siyam to Usman Khan, 1 run, wristy whip down to long-on for a single. 43 needed now to win. Pakistan doing it in a hurry 15.5 SK Jarif Siyam to Hayam Khan, 1 run, flogged down off the bottom hand for a single down to long-on. That was a tossed up delivery outside off 15.4 SK Jarif Siyam to Usman Khan, 1 run, flatter one, outside off, punched down to long-off for a single 15.3 4 SK Jarif Siyam to Usman Khan, FOUR , hit hard, hit in the gap and along the carpet for a four. That was a fuller length delivery, outside off, Usman Khan got the bat down and put it away wide of cover 15.2 4 SK Jarif Siyam to Usman Khan, FOUR , backs away, tossed up delivery, Usman Khan gets under the ball and smacks it over cover. Lovely inside out drilled hit by Usman Khan 15.1 F SK Jarif Siyam to Hayam Khan, 1 run, tossed up delivery, driven down to long-on for a single. Fifty for Hayam Khan. He has taken his chances today and that has come off so far Over 15 84-0 0 0 6 1 0 1 ( 8 runs) Hayam Khan 49 (52) Usman Khan 35 (38) Robiul Hasan Anik 1-0-8-0 Over Summary View all overs 14.6 Robiul Hasan Anik to Hayam Khan, 1 run, sends the ball down to deep cover by trekking back. Hayam Khan moves to 49. He has come in and made an immdiate impact 14.5 Robiul Hasan Anik to Hayam Khan, no run, dabs the flatter one down to short third man 14.4 Robiul Hasan Anik to Usman Khan, 1 run, short ball, hangs back and stabs it down to point. The fielder fumbled and allowed the single 14.3 6 Robiul Hasan Anik to Usman Khan, SIX , pounces on the short ball! He was quick to rock back and slam the pull over deep mid.
